gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
He ___ the flu last week and missed the finals.
gaps.explanation: 'catch the flu/a cold' = become ill with it.

gaps.sentence: ___ being nervous, she delivered a flawless speech.
She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: This time yesterday we ___ on the beach.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous for an action in progress at a past moment.

gaps.sentence: She was made ___ for three hours at the airport.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'be made' takes to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.
